summary: The cost check measures GET /v1/client/runtime-starts, GET /v1/client/schedules, POST /v1/agents/rename-id and POST /v1/missions/rename-id, which had no probe since 10-21 and 10-22 and kept the daily perf-cost lane red. Its route coverage check and route-inventory units now also run in every pull request, so a new route without a probe or a reason fails in its own pull request.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to drop the four probes and run the coverage check only in perf-cost again.
